    "Steeper learning curve for occasional users like contractors",
    "Mobile experience might not always be seamless for quick receipt capture"

  "overall_experience": "This contractor likely found SAP Concur to be a powerful tool for centralizing travel and expense management within their mid-market company. While its comprehensive functionality for bookings, receipts, and approvals was appreciated, the user experience could sometimes feel less intuitive, leading to occasional frustration with navigation or speed. The system fulfilled its core purpose of expense tracking and reporting, but its ease of use might have been a point of contention for someone focused on quick, efficient administrative tasks."
